# ssp_alarms (Data Source)

Lists alarm instances matching an optional filter.

Corresponds to `POST /ssp/alarms`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `feature_names` (List of String) Filter to alarm instances for these feature names.
- `severities` (List of String) Filter to alarm instances with these severities.
- `states` (List of String) Filter to alarm instances in these states (`OPEN`, `ACKNOWLEDGED`, `SUPPRESSED`, `RESOLVED`).

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) Alarm instances matching the filter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>

### Nested Schema for `results`

Read-Only:

- `definition_id` (String)
- `feature_name` (String)
- `id` (String)
- `resource_id` (String)
- `severity` (String)
- `state` (String)
- `summary` (String)
- `value` (String)
